g.text: Our rough estimate (not in the book): 3 dB/cm alone would allow Q of

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: order 10⁵ (Eq. 6.20, n_g ≈ 4 assumed). But the loss element covers only

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: part of the ring (length πR), and the couplers may add loss too.

g.text: Takeaway: two S-parameter couplers + a phase modulator + 3 dB/cm loss make a ring: at every resonance the through port dips, the drop port peaks, and each gets a Q.
